guard: deliver pending names each candidate's sender by its display label and its subject-pinned principal instead of interpolating the from object
why: The CLI imports @cotal-ai/delivery through its dist output, so the command rebuilds delivery before the suite and each mutation rebuilds it after restore. No dist compiled from a mutant is left behind.

mutations.name: the candidate line interpolates the from object again
mutations.expectRed: `deliver pending dave` names the candidate's sender by label and principal
mutations.cell: `deliver pending dave` names the candidate's sender by label and principal
mutations.note: This restores the shipped defect: the line reads from=[object Object].

mutations.name: the candidate line drops the sender principal
mutations.expectRed: `deliver pending dave` names the candidate's sender by label and principal
mutations.cell: `deliver pending dave` names the candidate's sender by label and principal
mutations.note: The display label alone is sender-chosen text; the principal is the identity the broker pinned.
